text: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "order_items"."ordered_at" >= '2025-07-01' AND "order_items"."ordered_at" < '2025-08-01' THEN "order_items"."product_price" ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_jul_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN "order_items"."ordered_at" >= '2025-08-01' AND "order_items"."ordered_at" < '2025-09-01' THEN "order_items"."product_price" ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_aug_2025, (SUM(CASE WHEN "order_items"."ordered_at" >= '2025-08-01' AND "order_items"."ordered_at" < '2025-09-01' THEN "order_items"."product_price" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "order_items"."ordered_at" >= '2025-07-01' AND "order_items"."ordered_at" < '2025-08-01' THEN "order_items"."product_price" ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "order_items"."ordered_at" >= '2025-07-01' AND "order_items"."ordered_at" < '2025-08-01' THEN "order_items"."product_price" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_change_pct FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS "order_items"
